#### **2. Tools for Informed Betting (If You Proceed)**

import requests

def scrape_odds(sport, competition, event_url):
    headers = {
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36'
    }
    response = requests.get(event_url, headers=headers)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, 'html.parser')

    odds_data = []

        cells = row.find_all('td')
        if len(cells) >= 3:  # Adjust based on actual table structure
            team = cells[0].text.strip()
            odd = cells[1].text.strip()
            bookie = cells[2].text.strip()
            odds_data.append({'team': team, 'odd': odd, 'bookie': bookie})

    return odds_data
